none: PAS CAM-ACB886: Roman Coin : Two Victories, each holding a wreath over a heart
contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
R/ [VICTORIAE DD] AVGGQ NN ; D/ [...] S P F AVG

A copper-alloy nummus, probably of Constans (AD 337-50), dating toAD 347-348 (Reece period 17). Reverse legend reads [VICTORIAE DD] AVGGQ NN. Reverse shows two Victories, each holding a wreath over a leaf. Obverse legend reads [...] S P F AVG. Obverse shows a diademed, draped and cuirassed bust right. Die axis is 6 o'clock. Weight is 1.32g, diameter is 14.0mm, thickness is 1.7mm. Mint of Trier,…
